note: Upstream 7-Zip for macOS (7-zip.org), the universal 7zz binary. Replaces the Homebrew p7zip 17.06 repack - Homebrew is treated as not installed on every Mac (Craig, 2026-08-29). Downloaded at setup ('Download tools') or on demand, never bundled; verified by SHA-256. Optional: ISOs are read by mounting them, 7zz only speeds up cab/driver-pack work.

macos_arm64.notes: Universal binary (arm64 + x86_64) - the same archive serves both macOS keys.

macos_amd64.notes: Universal binary (arm64 + x86_64) - the same archive serves both macOS keys.
